summary.text: Joe Sempolinski is a Republican member of the New York State Assembly representing District 148, which he has represented since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He previously served in the U.S. House of Representatives for New York's 23rd District from 2022 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Sempolinski was born in Elmira, New York, and lives in Canisteo, New York.
He graduated from Corning-Painted Post West High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University in 2005 and a master's degree from Yale University in 2009.

His career experience includes working as a consultant with Killbuck Strategies, as chief of staff for a New York State Assembly member, and as director of development at Archbishop Walsh High School.
